data.summary: Recovered the stopped FD-104 Worker handoff and restored the Python sequential-call setting. The focused config test passes; endpoint acceptance remains failed because the backend repeatedly returned function_call after tool outputs.

aiw fd claim FD-104 FD-104-000011-work-requested --session fd104-worker-20261108-recovery
python -c <in-memory compile of openai_api_runtime.py, test_parallel_tool_call_setting.py, and fd104_test_tool_call.py>

temporary Python 3.12 venv: pip install -r workers/process-python/requirements.txt
temporary Python 3.12 venv: pip install httpx==0.28.1

GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off go run . start --config C:\green\aiw\gateway.json; run fd104_test_tool_call.py against source gateway; agent-gateway.exe stop --config C:\green\aiw\gateway.json
results: Worker recovery was recorded through the CLI after the user confirmed the prior session had stopped; the new handoff was claimed by the current Worker session.
Python compile-only check passed for the three changed Python files.
aiw-de production changes were committed as cd5d632; the field default preserves existing positional ApiRuntimeConfig construction.
Dependencies were installed only into %TEMP%\aiw-fd104-20261108: openai-agents==0.24.0, openai==3.46.0, httpx==0.28.1. No repository dependency manifest changed.
The focused configuration unit test passed all 4 tests after the test fixture was corrected to include service_tier. The scoped correction was committed to aiw-de develop as 857c280.
Against the installed gateway, the endpoint returned HTTP 400 invalid_request before execution; audit recorded execution_started=false. The installed binary is older than FD source.

Against the current source gateway, turn 1 returned a valid function_call with parallel_tool_calls=false. After tool output 42 was submitted, turns 2 and 3 returned additional function_call outputs. The SDK executed the function three times and raised MaxTurnsExceeded; TOOL_CALL_OK:42 was not observed.

Static diagnosis: decodeRequest matches function_call/function_call_output IDs and flattens them into the next prompt; appInstructions includes caller instructions and tool-result policy; executeApp maps the backend's next decision to a new Responses function_call. The trace shows this path returned 200 and tool output 42 was submitted before the backend repeated the call. Evidence supports a model/backend response or model-dependent acceptance-oracle hypothesis, but does not confirm a gateway schema/sequential-setting defect or establish why the backend ignored the instruction. Both gateway instances were stopped gracefully.
Endpoint acceptance remains failed. No Go tests, broad Python suite, or further endpoint retries were run; the focused runtime budget is exhausted.
Updated Worker evidence is linked by FD-104-000017-needs-decision (source event FD-104-000015-needs-decision, target human); the CLI dispatched no agent.
data.residual_risk: The one-call acceptance remains unresolved because the configured backend returned repeated function_call outputs over three turns despite receiving output 42. The prior independent review remains changes-requested. A fresh explicit test cycle or a decision on the model-dependent acceptance approach is required before review and archive.
